name: Remove first volumes of fMRI
summary: Removes the first N volumes of a 4D fMRI image with nilearn and outputs the trimmed BOLD series.
description: Loads the BOLD image with nilearn and drops the first n_vols volumes, a common step to discard non-steady-state volumes before fMRI preprocessing. It needs a 4D task fMRI image; only the BOLD file is used and other files of the input are not carried over.

outputs.description: BOLD image (bold.nii.gz) with the first n_vols volumes removed.

parameters.description: Number of initial volumes to remove from the start of the BOLD series.
parameters.placeholder: Number of volumes to be removed

citations.text: Avesani P, et al. The open diffusion data derivatives, brain data upcycling via integrated publishing of derivatives and reproducible open cloud services. Sci Data 6:69 (2019).
